name: Battery health, temperature and cycle count
plain: Android 14 lets apps read battery cycle count and health; iOS shows none of this to apps.
meaning: Reveals how old and worn a phone is (cycle count, capacity percent), which is a strong device-age and value signal and a stable fingerprint bit set.

android.note: Temperature readable since API 1 in tenths of a degree C; cycle count and health added in API 34

ios.api_surface: No public API for cycle count, capacity or temperature
ios.note: Only the person can see Battery Health in Settings; thermalState is the coarse heat proxy

limits.headline: Can see battery health and charge cycles on Android 14 and newer, but not on iPhone
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks when it starts or on a timer
can: See battery cycle count and health on Android 14 and newer
See battery temperature on any Android version
Use it to guess how worn your phone is
cannot: See battery cycle count, capacity or temperature on iPhone; there is no public tool
Guess battery health on older Android before version 14
Show more than a rough heat level on iPhone, using the thermal state
limits.differs: Android 14 shows apps cycle count and health. iPhone shows apps none of it; only you can see it in Settings.

story.what_it_is: Android 14 lets apps read how worn your battery is.
story.for_you: You never see it. An app can learn how many times your battery has charged and how healthy it is. That can show how old the phone is and what it might be worth.
story.for_makers: Trade in and resale apps use it for a fair quote. Games and utilities use it to adapt. It is also a stable detail that can help build a phone fingerprint.

use_cases.example: A phone trade in app reads cycle count to price your used phone.
A battery care app shows capacity and cycle count and warns when it is worn.
A heavy game lowers quality on a worn battery to avoid sudden shutdowns.
A fraud tool uses battery wear as one more fingerprint detail.
A fleet manager tracks which company phones need new batteries.
A watch app checks the phone battery wear before a long sync.

story.android_note: Available on Android 14 and later to apps with no prompt.
story.ios_note: iPhone shows battery health in Settings, but apps cannot read it.

technical_bounds: Android values can be null if the OEM does not report them

history.change: Cycle count and state of health exposed to apps
Apple added in-app battery throttling, but no app API
